text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
There's something serious I want to<n>talk to you
about.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure you've noticed that my<n>performance has
been slipping lately.<n>I just can't seem to put my
heart into<n>it.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I know you have a plan to get me<n>back on track, but
I won't be able to<n>win over the world if I just keep
forcing myself to keep going.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
So I'd like to ask for some time to<n>regroup. I'll need
it for the sake of<n>making our dreams a reality, so I
hope you understand.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl walks off briskly.<n>I'll need to
rethink her upcoming race<n>schedule.
